title: Global Survey: Hyper Disruption and Digitization Leading Forces of Change Within Business
summary: PRESS RELEASE: New study reveals 94% of survey respondents are facing disruption and under pressure to rethink approach to keep pace. Read more.
body_markdown: Teradata empowers enterprises to turn intelligence into autonomous action, grounding AI agents in deep business context and trusted data.
